step1.description:
Some people think that there are too many JS Frameworks. But this is even more compounded by the fact they often spawn several Metaframeworks. Each with different opinions and approaches. But at their core are they all the same? 

Nikhil Saraf joins the stream once again to show off his latest project, Vinxi, which  closes the gap between bundler and framework. There have been several attempts at agnostic tools in the space. Has he finally found the solution?
